payload.answer: Jobs are created by the existing intake/design/build flow; the operator names ids explicitly. The part needing a real decision is failure: if one job of a named set fails, do the others continue, get cancelled, or finish and report? Do NOT default to killing siblings -- these jobs are independent units of work that happen to have been named together, and destroying completed work because a sibling failed is a bad trade. Default: let the others run to completion, report a consolidated result naming which failed. Anything stronger needs a stated reason.
